dict.string: Boulito reads your calendar when you ask (“what do I have tomorrow?”) and adds an event only after your spoken “yes”. It never changes or deletes anything.
Boulito reads your calendar when you ask and adds an event only after your spoken “yes”.
Boulito listens to your command while you hold the talk key (or after its name in always-listening mode). Nothing is recorded; everything stays on this Mac.
Boulito controls the YouTube tab in Safari when you ask (playback, search, player) and the Music app. It never acts on other websites.
